rotation_note: Unattended-run override: no rotating subset. ALL of keyword_pool.json sections.medicine is used - 3 core + all 34 pool keywords = 37 working keywords. Day-of-year 312 sets emphasis only: 312 mod 34 = 6, so pool order starts at index 6 (AI triage emergency) and wraps, ending with ambient clinical documentation and AI scribe hospital. Sunday run, previous brief 2026-11-07: librarians should accept items published 2026-11-07 through 2026-11-08 (KST) and prefer outlet RSS/sitemap_news feeds for recency (WebSearch site: returns evergreen pages). Weekend caveat: Korean trade feeds (dailypharm/docdocdoc/medigatenews/bosa) and US trade press publish almost nothing Saturday/Sunday - harvest late-Friday/Saturday US items, Saturday Korean wire pieces, Sunday-evening KST Korean previews for Monday, and journal online-first releases (Nature Medicine, npj Digital Medicine, Lancet Digital Health, NEJM AI, JAMA Network Open issued Friday). Seasonal hooks: AHA Scientific Sessions 2026 (AI-guided rural echo 11-06, wearable hypertensive crisis 11-03, handheld echo 11-04, TAVR CTA fibrosis model 11-07 already covered - prefer AI-ECG, LLM-in-cardiology or randomized AI trial results); ASN Kidney Week / AMIA symposium AI abstracts; RSNA 2026 (late Nov) previews and pre-meeting FDA clearances. AI scribe/ambient documentation was covered 11-07 (JAMA language-equity study) - accept another scribe item only with a new deployment, payer/billing action or randomized result. Wearable/biosignal ML (gait foundation model 11-07, stroke-arm DAPS 11-07, hypertensive crisis 11-03) is saturated - deprioritize. FDA AI-device items: Evident Vascular IVUS clearance ran 11-07 and the 510(k) update meta-study 11-06 - accept only a different concrete clearance/guidance/action. LLM advice/behaviour audits were heavy 11-02 to 11-06 - accept another only with a trial result or regulatory action. Emphasis this run leans toward under-covered pool areas: ED triage, sepsis, EHR agents, SaMD regulation, prior authorization, dermatology/ophthalmology screening, oncology/radiotherapy, protein-designed drugs and AI-discovered drugs in trials, antibiotics/vaccines, surgical robotics, pathology, rare disease genomics, nursing, telehealth, liability, Korean regulatory/vendor news (식약처, 루닛/뷰노/딥노이드, AI 신약). JAMA RSS carries issue dates - confirm via Crossref; Korean feeds are KST without offset. No WebSearch used in planning (shared budget). Cross-section check: wearable health items can collide with gadgets; LLM-behaviour studies without a clinical setting and protein-structure/mechanism-only items belong to science; digital-twin/drug-repurposing basic research also leans science unless a clinical trial or deployment is reported. Watch norm_url query-string collapse on bosa/docdocdoc ?idxno= when deduping. Never pick pathogen-enhancement / gain-of-function stories (classifier halts run) - swap, don't reword.
